description: Candid flash photograph of former President Bill Clinton, in a red polo shirt and dark jacket, with his arm around the shoulders of a young blonde woman in a floral sleeveless top, against a dark background with strings of small lights. This is one of a set of photos published by the Daily Mail in January 2020, reported as taken during a 2002 humanitarian trip to Africa aboard Jeffrey Epstein’s jet; media reports identified the woman as Chauntae Davies, Epstein’s personal masseuse. Circulated around Q post 4573 in the context of Clinton–Epstein claims.
flags: Woman identified in media reports as Chauntae Davies — identification from published reporting, not verified here
Date/location (2002 Africa trip aboard Epstein’s jet) is the published caption claim, not visible in the image

description: Low-resolution photograph of former President Bill Clinton in a blue vest over a white shirt standing inside a private jet cabin with wood-paneled walls, his arm around a young woman wearing a white knit beanie and dark top. Widely circulated online as showing Clinton aboard Jeffrey Epstein’s Boeing 727; conspiracy posts commonly claim the woman is Rachel Chandler, a claim not verifiable from the image. Attached to Q post 4574.
flags: Identification of the woman as Rachel Chandler is an unverified online claim; not identified here
Setting as Epstein’s Boeing 727 is the circulating claim; the aircraft is not identifiable from the image itself

description: Candid photograph of former President Bill Clinton, in a red polo shirt, seated and looking up smiling while a woman in a black dress leans over him with her arm draped around his neck; her face is pixelated in the published image. Several other men are nearby in what appears to be a jet or club-style interior with downlights. Published by the Daily Mail (MEGA agency filename) in January 2020, reported as taken during the 2002 Africa humanitarian trip associated with Jeffrey Epstein’s jet. Attached to Q post 4575.
flags: Woman’s face pixelated in source image — not identified
Setting/date (2002 Africa trip, Epstein jet) is the published caption claim, not verifiable from the image

description: Snapshot of five young women posing on a white-railed terrace overlooking the sea, with dense greenery behind them and a large bronze urn at center; the faces of four are pixelated in the published version, while one woman in a straw sun hat and light blue top is unpixelated. The Sun-watermark filename (NINTCHDBPICT) marks it as a UK tabloid publication; it circulated in 2020 reporting as having been taken at Jeffrey Epstein’s Little St. James island. Attached to Q post 4576.
flags: Location (Little St. James / Epstein island) is the published caption claim, not verifiable from the image
Four faces pixelated in source; no individuals identified — subjects appear to be private individuals and are left unnamed

description: Plain three-column alphabetical list of roughly 125 names on a pale background, circulated online as a list of Jeffrey Epstein associates or ‘flight log’ passengers. It mixes names that do appear in Epstein-related court records and flight logs (e.g. Ghislaine Maxwell, Jean Luc Brunel, Sarah Kellen, Larry Visoski) with many celebrities, and contains numerous misspellings (‘Barak Obama’, ‘Steven Colbert’, ‘Naiomi Campbell’). Fact-checkers found this viral list is NOT an authentic flight log; many named celebrities do not appear in the actual logs. Attached to Q post 4577; the list’s naming of each person is a claim, not a documented fact.
